class.name: AttributeModifier
class.brief_description: One attribute change carried by a [GameplayEffect].
class.description: Applies [code]ADD[/code], [code]MULTIPLY[/code] or [code]OVERRIDE[/code] to a named attribute. See [AttributeSet] for how the operations combine.

method.name: apply
method.description: Applies this modifier to [param input_value] alone. [AbilitySystemComponent] combines every active modifier instead; this is for computing a preview.

method.name: apply_magnitude
method.description: The operation applied to [param input_value] with a magnitude worked out elsewhere.

method.name: calculate_magnitude
method.description: The magnitude for one application, from [member magnitude_type]. Evaluated once, when the effect is applied: an attribute-based bonus is a snapshot of the attribute then, not a live link to it.

members.member: The attribute this modifier changes, by name.
Whose attribute an attribute-based magnitude reads: the spec's source, or the target it is applied to. With no source, the target stands in.
The attribute an attribute-based magnitude reads.

Scalable float: when set, [member magnitude] is multiplied by the curve sampled at the spec's level. Set the curve's domain to the levels used and its value range to the multipliers - a [Curve] clamps to its range.
The amount. What it means depends on [member operation]: an addend, a factor, or the value itself.
How [member magnitude] is combined with the attribute's value.
Attribute based: added after the coefficient.
Attribute based: added to the attribute before the coefficient.
Set by caller: the name the value is looked up under in the spec. When the spec has none, [member magnitude] is used and a warning printed.

constants.constant: Added to the running value. Every [constant ADD] on an attribute is summed.
Multiplied into the running value, after every [constant ADD] has been summed.
Replaces the value outright. A single [constant OVERRIDE] beats every [constant ADD] and [constant MULTIPLY] on that attribute.
[member magnitude], scaled by [member level_curve] when there is one.
Computed from an attribute of the source or the target.
Whatever the spec was given under [member set_by_caller_name].
The component that made the spec.
The component the effect is applied to.
